title: Anti-Inflammatory Activity of Pyrazolo[1,5-a]quinazolines.
authors: Crocetti, Letizia; Khlebnikov, Andrei I; Guerrini, Gabriella; Schepetkin, Igor A; Melani, Fabrizio; Giovannoni, Maria Paola; Quinn, Mark T
one_liner_zh: 该文研究吡唑并喹唑啉类化合物的抗炎活性及其与MAPK激酶的分子结合，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Chronic inflammation contributes to a number of diseases. Therefore, control of the inflammatory response is an important therapeutic goal. To identify novel anti-inflammatory compounds, we synthesized and screened a library of 80 pyrazolo[1,5-a]quinazoline compounds and related derivatives. Screening of these compounds for their ability to inhibit lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) transcriptional activity in human THP-1Blue monocytic cells identified 13 compounds with anti-inflammatory activity (IC(50) < 50 microM) in a cell-based test system, with two of the most potent being compounds 13i (5-[(4-sulfamoylbenzyl)oxy]pyrazolo[1,5-a]quinazoline-3-carboxamide) and 16 (5-[(4-(methylsulfinyl)benzyloxy]pyrazolo[1,5-a]quinazoline-3-carboxamide). Pharmacophore mapping of potential targets predicted that 13i and 16 may be ligands for three mitogen-activated protein kinases (MAPKs), including extracellular signal-regulated kinase 2 (ERK2), p38alpha, and c-Jun N-terminal kinase 3 (JNK3). Indeed, molecular modeling supported that these compounds could effectively bind to ERK2, p38alpha, and JNK3, with the highest complementarity to JNK3. The key residues of JNK3 important for this binding were identified. Moreover, compounds 13i and 16 exhibited micromolar binding affinities for JNK1, JNK2, and JNK3. Thus, our results demonstrate the potential for developing lead anti-inflammatory drugs based on the pyrazolo[1,5-a]quinazoline and related scaffolds that are targeted toward MAPKs.
abstract_zh: 慢性炎症与多种疾病的发生相关。因此，控制炎症反应是重要的治疗目标。为发现新型抗炎化合物，我们合成并筛选了一个包含80种吡唑并[1,5-a]喹唑啉化合物及其相关衍生物的库。通过筛选这些化合物抑制人THP-1Blue单核细胞中脂多糖（LPS）诱导的核因子κB（NF-κB）转录活性的能力，我们在细胞基测试系统中鉴定出13种具有抗炎活性的化合物（IC(50) < 50 μM），其中两种效力最强的为化合物13i（5-[(4-磺酰胺苄基)氧基]吡唑并[1,5-a]喹唑啉-3-甲酰胺）和16（5-[(4-(甲基亚磺酰基)苄氧基]吡唑并[1,5-a]喹唑啉-3-甲酰胺）。对潜在靶点的药效团映射预测，13i和16可能是三种丝裂原活化蛋白激酶（MAPKs）的配体，包括细胞外信号调节激酶2（ERK2）、p38α和c-Jun N末端激酶3（JNK3）。确实，分子建模支持这些化合物能有效结合ERK2、p38α和JNK3，其中与JNK3的互补性最高。我们鉴定了JNK3中对此结合至关重要的关键残基。此外，化合物13i和16对JNK1、JNK2和JNK3表现出微摩尔级的结合亲和力。因此，我们的结果表明，基于吡唑并[1,5-a]喹唑啉及相关骨架开发靶向MAPKs的先导抗炎药物具有潜力。
